source_note: Treasury, Stats NZ, Inland Revenue and RBNZ. June fiscal years. Spending and tax in NZ dollars; real values use the mean of the four quarterly CPI levels in each June year, scaled to 2025/26. Tax by source uses Treasury's unconsolidated total tax series.
